title: GTA VI breaks traffic record at Europe’s largest internet exchange ahead of launch

blocks.text: Early downloads of Grand Theft Auto VI drove internet traffic at DE CIX Frankfurt, Europe's largest internet exchange, to a record 22.3 terabits per second on Friday (November 13), a roughly 19% jump that the exchange's chief technology officer attributed to the long-awaited video game.
